stem.text: A desk has a true width of $50.0\,\text{cm}$.
Two students, X and Y, measure the width of the desk.
Student X uses a tape measure and records a width of $(49.5 \pm 0.5)\,\text{cm}$.
Student Y uses a metre rule and records a width of $(51.4 \pm 0.1)\,\text{cm}$.
Which statement about the measurement of student X is correct?

A.text: It is less accurate and less precise than the measurement of student Y.

B.text: It is less accurate but more precise than the measurement of student Y.

C.text: It is more accurate and more precise than the measurement of student Y.

D.text: It is more accurate but less precise than the measurement of student Y.
